values.note: $20 a night per the DNR amenity table, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (McCollum Lake State Forest Campground, Oscoda, managed by Clinton Township: 20 sites, $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/mccollumlake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Small picnic area; boat ramp on site.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/mccollumlake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'This rustic campground includes a small picnic area and adjacent boat launch.' 'Ramp access on site.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/mccollumlake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 20 sites: 11 'will accommodate larger 40-ft vehicle trailers'; three (elsewhere on the page, four) are walk-in tent-only sites. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/mccollumlake ('This campground contains 20 sites, three sites are walk-in for tent only camping and 11 sites will accommodate larger 40-ft vehicle trailers.'; 'Four walk-in sites (out of a total of 20 sites).'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site.') + amenity table (20 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground on McCollum Lake, 6 mi SE of Curran (Oscoda County), run by Clinton Township. Open-field layout with minimal tree cover. Pike, bass, walleye and panfish in the lake; Au Sable River trout ten miles south, with carry-in access at Lost Creek. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 20 sites, 11 taking 40-ft trailers (count and max 40 ft confirmed), $20 (amenity table row) + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season not stated (amenity table: 'contact manager'); no Clinton Township page for the campground found. Type 'rustic', ORV operation 'no'; no equestrian wording. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Phone: the entry's 989-848-8545 is Clinton Township, the manager, which the DNR page names for 'Any concerns or questions about this campground'; the same page's Contact box lists 989-590-7366. Kept the township number.

Ownership/agency: run by Clinton Township on state forest land (DNR page and amenity table 'Managed by: Clinton Township'); the township posts no campground page. Aggregators (Campendium $13, outdoorithm $15 plus a $4 trash-bag fee) report lower fees than the DNR table's $20; unconfirmed.
